cards.title: Lock after the idempotency pre-check
items: A deliberate, documented trade-off: two first-uses of the same key can both miss that read
The second is refused 409 by the database's own unique index on (CallingSystem, IdempotencyKey), not silently double-posted

cards.title: What this can't show
items: The per-account lock is single-process, in-memory — correct for one instance, not a horizontally-scaled deployment
The account's own status-gate and floor rules are Accounts' domain logic, applied here through TryApplyPosting
